_comment: Soundtrack spec for AG Racer. Each entry becomes one generated track. Tags drive ACE-Step; keep them comma-separated and concrete (genre, tempo, instrumentation, mood). `duration` is seconds. `seed` keeps a take reproducible - change it to roll a different take of the same brief. Direction: synth-forward EDM over drum-and-bass beats. Avoid distortion/industrial/guitar words - they pull the model toward rock.
